description: Force this tenant's search index to re-chunk (and re-embed, if a provider is configured) one document (document_id) or, without document_id, every document, on the indexer's next tick.

document_id.description: Reindex only this document; omit to reindex every document.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.docs.reindex
